environment.tool: scripts/probes/rce/row.py sweep 2026-11-18 (control-first, exact request bytes, executing peer)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['GET //x?a%0d%0aGET%20/exec%3fcmd=id%0d%0aHost:%20u%0d%0a%20HTTP/1.1 HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `afdc173f:56` (`decode`, query kept undecoded) and `:80` (`proxy`).
findings.title: request_line_split: verified upstream-side RCE (high)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['GET //exec ?cmd=id HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `afdc173f:77` (`cacheget` tries `"*"` first), `:78` (`cacheput`).
findings.title: cache_exec_poison: verified upstream-side RCE (critical)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw status=HTTP/1.1 200 OK executions=2 flaky=['GET //exec ?cmd=id HTTP/1.1'] healthy=['GET //exec ?cmd=id HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `afdc173f:80` (`proxy` retry contract), `FINDING_r13_C.md:49-83`.
findings.title: retry_double_exec: verified upstream-side RCE (medium)

limitations: Covers the eight request-smuggling RCE families of the rce_matrix; static-only findings from the earlier audits are recorded in their own envelopes.
